name: bench
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. It fixes the materials and light only.
prompt: Paint a new asset in exactly the material language of Image 1: the EMPTY dark glass research-bench ground, a wide flat panoramic view filling the whole canvas edge to edge. Deep blue-teal glass lab surface with a very subtle brushed and polished depth, soft painted gradients, a faint cool vignette at all edges. A single soft cool cone of light falls from the top edge about one third of the way across from the left (slightly angled from the upper left), widening as it descends and ending in a soft luminous pool on the surface about 62 percent of the way down, exactly like the beam over the pod in Image 1. Nothing else: no pod, no cradle, no pedestal, no panes, no frames, no stamp, no tabs, no wells, no bars, no text, no numbers, no icons, no UI. Painted light and soft shadows, no dither bands, no flat fills, no noise grain. Flat front-on view, no perspective props.

name: cradle
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. Look at the frosted glass cradle ring with its glass shelf under the pod.
prompt: Paint only the glass cradle from Image 1 (the frosted glass shallow ring-dish sitting on its thin glass shelf plate), exactly its design and material: thick frosted glass, lit rim at the upper left, soft refraction, pale cyan highlights, soft contact shadow. The cradle is EMPTY (no pod in it, no dust, no plate). Show it alone, centred, seen from the same slightly raised front angle, on a perfectly flat uniform dark blue-teal background colour (hex 1B2C3A), with generous empty margin around it. No text, no numbers, no other object.

name: pod-loika
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. The pod in the centre is the object to paint.
prompt: Paint only the pod from Image 1 (the squat charcoal egg-shaped shell with the cream dots and the cream seam bands, the cream cap with the three-leaf glyph and its hairline crack), exactly its design, proportions, material and painted light, lit softly from the upper left, a faint warm inner glow at the seams. Show it alone, centred, standing on nothing (its flat foot at the lower part of the canvas), seen from the same slightly raised front angle, on a perfectly flat uniform pure magenta background (hex FF00FF) with generous margin. No cradle, no dust, no shadow on the ground, no text, no numbers.

name: tab-sheet
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. Look at the chapter tabs at the top: slanted-side glass tabs with lit rims.
prompt: Paint a flat sheet of four EMPTY rail tab plates side by side with equal gaps, each a wide low horizontal plate (about 2:1, slightly slanted lower corners) in the exact glass-and-metal language of the tabs in Image 1, seen straight on, no perspective, no text, no icons, no lamps, no emblems, no marks. From left to right: (1) UNREAD: cool pale frost-blue frosted glass with a hairline outline; (2) READ: solid deep teal glass with a lit aqua rim; (3) FOCUSED: lit bright rim, slightly brighter face, cream-white edge glow at the top; (4) SEALED: the plate drawn shut with horizontal slats and a small notch cut into its bottom edge. On a perfectly flat uniform pure magenta background (hex FF00FF). All four the same size and aligned on one baseline. No text at all.

name: page-pane
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. Look at the large glass pane on the right of the stage plate and the framed page on the left; they fix the material.
prompt: Paint one EMPTY tall rectangular deep glass page pane, seen straight on and filling the canvas edge to edge with no margin: a deep blue-teal frosted-glass panel with a thin lit slate edge all around (1 px hairline feel), a soft lighter top-left edge reflection, a very soft inner shadow near the edges, smooth painted depth in the middle. The middle is calm and nearly uniform (it will hold pictures later). No picture, no text, no numbers, no heading, no icons, no marks. Painted light, no dither bands, no noise grain.

name: frame-sheet
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. Look at the picture frame holding the painting on the left: a thin lit glass bezel.
prompt: Paint one EMPTY picture frame bezel seen straight on filling the canvas edge to edge: a thin lit glass-and-slate bezel lip around the whole border (about 2 percent of the width thick), with a soft bevel, a bright upper-left rim, a darker lower-right edge, and the entire inside area a perfectly flat uniform pure magenta (hex FF00FF) that will be removed. No picture, no text, no marks, no corners ornaments, no shadow outside. The outer edge touches the canvas edge.

name: well
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. Look at the empty wells in the left column and the lit current well at the top.
prompt: Paint two EMPTY pod wells side by side, seen straight on, each a round glass well (circular recessed bezel with a thin circular ring groove around it, the inside a smooth dark glass bowl, empty, no pod) exactly in the design of the empty wells in the left column of Image 1. Left: the plain empty well. Right: the same well with its rim lit by a warm cream light (the current well in Image 1). Each well about 40 percent of the canvas width, centred vertically, on a perfectly flat uniform pure magenta background (hex FF00FF). No text, no numbers, no ring progress arcs, no stars.

name: hatch
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. Look at the small leaf mark at the bottom of the left column.
prompt: Paint one wide low glass hatch plate (a closed recessed hatch panel, 2:1, rounded corners, with a thin lit rim and a soft inner bevel) in the dark glass-and-graphite language of Image 1's left column, with a small fine engraved leaf mark in its centre like the one at the bottom of Image 1's left column (a single slim leaf outline, pale cyan hairline, about one quarter of the plate height). Seen straight on, on a perfectly flat uniform pure magenta background (hex FF00FF). No text, no numbers.
